استصبرتا (form X)
# اِسْتَصْبَرَتَا (istaṣbaratā) /is.tasˤ.ba.ra.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِسْتَصْبَرَ (istaṣbara)
# اُسْتُصْبِرَتَا (ustuṣbiratā) /us.tusˤ.bi.ra.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِسْتَصْبَرَ (istaṣbara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
